name: ship-safe
tagline: CLI security scanner for the agentic era
description: ship-safe is a CLI security scanner built for agentic development: it detects CI/CD misconfigurations, MCP tool injection, hardcoded secrets, and DMCA-flagged AI dependencies. As AI agents gain more privileges in the build pipeline, the attack surface moves — and this scanner targets exactly those new failure modes. It resurfaced on HN on 6 August with 821 stars.
highlights: Detects CI/CD misconfig and MCP tool injection
Catches hardcoded secrets and DMCA-flagged AI deps
Purpose-built for the agentic development era
821 stars and trending on HN again
curatorNote: Traditional scanners check your code; ship-safe checks your agent pipeline. MCP injection and AI dependencies are exactly where the next generation of supply-chain attacks will land.
